title: The Magic: The Gathering Oracle Deck

paragraphs.text: The Magic: The Gathering Oracle Deck is an officially licensed Magic: The Gathering themed oracle deck that was released on May 21, 2024. Oracle decks are a simpler version of Tarot cards. The deck is published by Clarkson Potter , an imprint of the Crown Publishing Group. It costs $24.99. The oracle cards are sized similarly to oversized Magic cards.
